The '''2025 Retro League Event 2''' was the second event of the [[2025 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], played from 16 March to 27 April 2025. The format was [[Premiere - Cloud City (Modified)]].<ref name="t85238" /> [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won.<ref name="t85238" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City (Modified)]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 16 March – 27 April 2025
* '''Players:''' 83 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]

== Final standings ==
Final standings as posted by the tournament director (posted as images), in posted order.
